name: Strak (7-8)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-10: In Burning Dawn

items.name: Orc Necksplitter
items.description: This single-bladed bearded axe has a jagged blade that's perfect for separating bone from tendon and cartilage.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire (Moderate) [Infused]
items.description:
Activate Strike

Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals 2d8 fire damage, 2 persistent fire damage, and 2 fire splash damage. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Acid Flask (Moderate) [Infused]
items.description:
Activate Strike

This flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 acid damage, 2d6 persistent acid damage, and 2 acid splash damage. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Alchemist's Tools
items.description: This mobile collection of vials and chemicals can be used for simple alchemical tasks.

items.name: Flint and Steel
items.description: Flint and steel are useful in creating a fire if you have the time to catch a spark, though using them is typically too time-consuming to be practical during an encounter. Even in ideal conditions, using flint and steel to light a flame requires using at least 3 actions, and often significantly longer.

items.name: Formula Book
items.description: A formula book holds the formulas necessary to make items other than the common equipment from this chapter; alchemists typically get one for free. Each formula book can hold the formulas for up to 100 different items. Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for you to copy them into a specific book as long as you can keep them on hand to reference them.

items.name: Elixir of Life (Lesser) [Infused]
items.description:
Activate Interact

Elixirs of life accelerate a living creatures natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, you regain 3d6+6 Hit Points and gain +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

items.name: Smokestick (Greater) [Infused]
items.description:
Activate Interact

With a sharp twist of this item, you instantly create a screen of thick, opaque smoke in a burst centered on one corner of your space. All creatures within that area are concealed, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind.

The radius of the burst is 20 feet.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ferocity
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The monster is reduced to 0 HP.

Effect The monster avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 HP, but its Wounded value increases by 1. When it is Wounded 3, it can no longer use this ability

offensiveAbilities.name: Directional Bombs
offensiveAbilities.description: When throwing an alchemical bomb with the splash trait, Strak can treat the target's space as the first affected square of a 15 foot cone directed away from him, potentially allowing him to avoid allies and splash deeper into enemy lines. If the target takes up more than a single square, the target's square closest to Strak is the first affected square of the cone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Bomber
offensiveAbilities.description: Strak draws an alchemical bomb with an Interact action and throws it as a ranged Strike.
